raw_response:
My land is only 1.5 mu, so I cannot make big mistakes. Cotton is what my family has always grown here in Quzhou, and last year I got about 280 jin per mu of seed cotton, which was okay but not great. I will stick with what I know.

For seed, I buy Bt hybrid cotton seed from the agricultural supply store in town — everyone around here uses Bt because the bollworm problem is too serious without it. A bag costs me around 40-50 yuan, enough for my small plot.

For base fertilizer before planting, I apply one bag of compound fertilizer (15-15-15, 40 kg) for my 1.5 mu — that is standard in our village. Then I topdress with urea twice during the season, about 15 kg each time. So for nitrogen I end up with roughly 18 kg per mu, phosphorus 6 kg per mu, potassium 6 kg per mu. I would rather apply a bit extra urea than lose bolls — urea is only 2 yuan per jin, but losing yield hurts much more.

I have well irrigation, so I water 3-4 times: once after planting to help emergence, once at squaring, once at flowering, once at bolling if the sky is dry.

Cotton needs many sprays. Aphids early, then mirids, then bollworms even with Bt. I will spray 7-8 times through the season. Pesticide is a big cost but I cannot skip it.

I plough once in winter and rotary till before planting. My neighbors do the same.
